tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. The table itself.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and sheets on ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Inputs on surface, chips, secondary buttons, empty art slots.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, outlines and decoration. Never text.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text, and the fill of the one primary button (ground text on it). The only accent.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: 8:1 on ground, 6:1 on raised.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Have it, legal, ready, done, connected. A result that's good for you.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Outside games only: need it, waiting, waiting for your OK, pending uploads.

tokens.name: pick
tokens.usage: In a game only: you can pick or play this. Never anything else on the board.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, banned; in a game, every warning. Always with a word.

tokens.name: good-tint
tokens.usage: Behind good text in a status pill.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Behind warn text in a status pill or an open-question panel.

tokens.name: bad-tint
tokens.usage: Behind bad text in a status pill.

tokens.name: on-art
tokens.usage: Text set on commander art, over a wash.

tokens.name: on-art-dim
tokens.usage: Second lines on commander art.

tokens.name: art-chip
tokens.usage: Near-solid chip behind small text on art (names, credits, badges).

tokens.name: seat-1
tokens.usage: You, in a game: seat dot, arrows, attack ring. Always beside a name or art.

tokens.name: seat-2
tokens.usage: Second seat in turn order.

tokens.name: seat-3
tokens.usage: Third seat in turn order.

tokens.name: seat-4
tokens.usage: Fourth seat in turn order.

tokens.name: seat-5
tokens.usage: Fifth seat in turn order.

tokens.name: seat-6
tokens.usage: Sixth seat in turn order.

tokens.name: mana-w
tokens.usage: White identity dot or pip. Mana colors only ever mean whose.

tokens.name: mana-u
tokens.usage: Blue identity dot or pip.

tokens.name: mana-b
tokens.usage: Black identity dot or pip.

tokens.name: mana-r
tokens.usage: Red identity dot or pip.

tokens.name: mana-g
tokens.usage: Green identity dot or pip.

tokens.name: mana-c
tokens.usage: Colorless identity dot or pip.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Deck title on its art hero (56 px on phones).

styles.name: tile-name
styles.usage: A deck's name on its art tile.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Approve it and the cards go on your shopping list.

styles.name: body-bold
styles.usage: Card names in a change, button labels.

styles.name: credit
styles.sample: Art: Name, © Wizards of the Coast

tokens.name: s-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label, chip rows.

tokens.name: s-2
tokens.usage: Inside lists and small cards.

tokens.name: s-3
tokens.usage: Default gap; phone page padding; panel padding.

tokens.name: s-4
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: s-5
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on phones and touch screens (pointer: coarse). On a laptop controls are 32-36 px.

tokens.name: target-primary
tokens.usage: The primary button on phones (48-56 px). On a laptop: control-desktop-primary.

tokens.name: content-w
tokens.usage: Content max-width on laptops.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: The laptop left rail (220-248 px).

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: The phone bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: control-desktop
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented controls, inputs and menu rows on a laptop (pointer: fine). Since 8 Nov: 44 px pills were too big on desktop.

tokens.name: control-desktop-primary
tokens.usage: The one primary button on a laptop.

tokens.name: control-compact
tokens.usage: Toolbar icon buttons and row actions (Skip, Undo) on a laptop.

tokens.name: stack-gap
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between a row of actions and the content above it. Nothing touches the thing before it.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page.

tokens.name: r-input
tokens.usage: Inputs and nav items.

tokens.name: r-control
tokens.usage: Secondary and toolbar buttons and menu panels on a laptop. Pills stay for the primary button, segmented controls and status pills.

tokens.name: r-list
tokens.usage: Lists and small cards.

tokens.name: r-panel
tokens.usage: Panels and art tiles (18-24 px).

tokens.name: r-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets, top corners only.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented controls, status pills.

tokens.name: r-tile
tokens.usage: Battlefield tiles and small art crops.

tokens.name: art-shadow
tokens.usage: text-shadow under big numbers set straight on an art wash.

tokens.name: active-ring
tokens.usage: The active player's panel, a picked tile.
